Container.Name: ngpost
Container.Overview: ngPost (Usenet uploader) built from source with PR #201 (filename obfuscation) and rebuilt on hotio/base:noblevpn so every upload is routed through a built-in WireGuard VPN. Packs files into multi-volume, password-protected RAR sets + PAR2 and writes RealName{{password}}.nzb so SABnzbd/NZBGet auto-extract.[br][br]Build the image first: docker build -t ngpost-hotio:latest /path/to/ngpost-hotio[br][br]SETUP:[br]1. Put your provider's WireGuard config at appdata/ngpost/wireguard/wg0.conf[br]2. Start the container once - it seeds an editable ngPost.conf into appdata/ngpost/[br]3. Edit ngPost.conf: set the [server] host/user/pass, and tune RAR_SIZE / PAR2_PCT / lengths[br]4. Point the Watch folder at where you drop files to upload[br][br]MODES (NGPOST_MODE):[br]poll = scan the Watch folder every NGPOST_INTERVAL seconds (works on /mnt/user).[br]monitor = ngPost's native inotify watcher (do NOT use on /mnt/user FUSE; map Watch to /mnt/cache or /mnt/diskX).[br]manual = idle; upload on demand: docker exec -u hotio ngpost ngpost-run[br][br]If the VPN tunnel fails to come up the container stops on purpose, so nothing uploads on your real IP.
Container.Description: ngPost on hotio/base with a built-in WireGuard VPN. See Overview for setup. Drop files in the Watch folder to upload them; finished NZBs land in the Output folder as RealName{{password}}.nzb.

Config.Name: Config (appdata)
Config.Description: Holds ngPost.conf, nzb/, tmp/, ngPost_history.csv and the VPN config at wireguard/wg0.conf

Config.Name: Watch (drop folder)
Config.Description: Drop files/folders here to upload them. NGPOST_INPUT_DIR points here. Created and chowned to PUID:PGID at startup if the host dir doesn't exist yet. With NGPOST_RM_POSTED=true, posted files are DELETED from here - treat it as a spool, not your only copy.

Config.Name: Output (NZBs)
Config.Description: Where finished NZBs are written, named RealName{{password}}.nzb. NGPOST_OUTPUT_DIR points here. Created and chowned to PUID:PGID at startup if the host dir doesn't exist yet.

Config.Name: Scratch (TMP_DIR, optional)
Config.Description: OPTIONAL: RAR + par2 are staged in TMP_DIR (/config/tmp). Large releases (tens of GB) need that much free space. Map this to a big/fast disk, e.g. /mnt/cache/appdata/ngpost-tmp, to keep it off /mnt/user/appdata. Leave blank to keep tmp inside the Config share.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run as.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode creation mask.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, e.g. America/New_York.

Config.Name: VPN_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the WireGuard VPN. When true a valid wg0.conf must exist under config/wireguard/.

Config.Name: VPN_CONF
Config.Description: WireGuard config name (config/wireguard/<name>.conf).

Config.Name: VPN_PROVIDER
Config.Description: generic, proton or pia. With pia, wg0.conf is generated for you.

Config.Name: VPN_LAN_NETWORK
Config.Description: Your LAN subnet(s) so they stay reachable while the VPN is up, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.

Config.Name: VPN_LAN_LEAK_ENABLED
Config.Description: Allow LAN traffic to bypass the kill switch.

Config.Name: VPN_HEALTHCHECK_ENABLED
Config.Description: Stop the container if VPN connectivity is lost (recommended to prevent leaks).

Config.Name: VPN_AUTO_PORT_FORWARD
Config.Description: Automatic port forwarding for proton/pia. Not needed for an outbound uploader.

Config.Name: VPN_PORT_REDIRECTS
Config.Description: Custom port redirect mappings (advanced).

Config.Name: VPN_EXPOSE_PORTS_ON_LAN
Config.Description: Selectively expose ports on the LAN (advanced).

Config.Name: VPN_NAMESERVERS
Config.Description: Override DNS servers used inside the tunnel (advanced).

Config.Name: VPN_INTERFACE_PREFIXES
Config.Description: Extra interface prefixes (advanced).

Config.Name: VPN_PIA_USER
Config.Description: PIA username (only if VPN_PROVIDER=pia).

Config.Name: VPN_PIA_PASS
Config.Description: PIA password (only if VPN_PROVIDER=pia).

Config.Name: VPN_PIA_PREFERRED_REGION
Config.Description: PIA region (only if VPN_PROVIDER=pia).

Config.Name: PRIVOXY_ENABLED
Config.Description: Run an HTTP proxy (Privoxy) on 8118 routed through the VPN.

Config.Name: UNBOUND_ENABLED
Config.Description: Run the Unbound DNS resolver.

Config.Name: UNBOUND_NAMESERVERS
Config.Description: Upstream nameservers for Unbound (advanced).

Config.Name: NGPOST_MODE
Config.Description: poll = re-scan the Watch folder every NGPOST_INTERVAL seconds and post new files (works on /mnt/user FUSE). monitor = ngPost's native inotify watcher, lower latency but does NOT fire on /mnt/user FUSE (map Watch to /mnt/cache or /mnt/diskX). manual = idle; upload on demand via 'docker exec -u hotio ngpost ngpost-run'.

Config.Name: NGPOST_INTERVAL
Config.Description: poll mode: seconds between scans of the Watch folder.

Config.Name: NGPOST_INPUT_DIR
Config.Description: Directory ngPost uploads from (inside the container). Match this to the Watch path target. Created and chowned to PUID:PGID at startup if it doesn't exist.

Config.Name: NGPOST_OUTPUT_DIR
Config.Description: Directory finished NZBs are written to (inside the container). Match this to the Output path target and the nzbPath / NZB_POST_CMD in ngPost.conf. Created and chowned to PUID:PGID at startup if it doesn't exist.

Config.Name: NGPOST_PACK
Config.Description: true = pass --pack so the conf's PACK line (COMPRESS, GEN_NAME, GEN_PASS, GEN_PAR2) is applied: passworded multi-volume RAR + par2. Set false only if you drive compression via NGPOST_ARGS instead.

Config.Name: NGPOST_RM_POSTED
Config.Description: true = pass --rm_posted: DELETE each file/folder from the Watch folder after it posts successfully. HARD-REQUIRED for poll mode -- ngPost has no resume DB, so without this every cycle would re-upload everything still in /watch. The container refuses to start in poll mode when this is false; use NGPOST_MODE=manual or monitor if you need sources to stay in place. Destructive: keep the Watch folder a spool, not your only copy.

Config.Name: NGPOST_ARGS
Config.Description: Extra ngPost flags appended to every run, e.g. --disp_progress files.
